goal: Prove a pinned Pascal 2D/3D workbench can operate as a local, disposable presentation organ under Aura's canonical Spatial lifecycle without changing Construction truth or authority.
positive_requirements: Pin exact Pascal repository commit, package versions, package metadata blob identities, integrity records, and MIT notice.
Add exact Pascal scene-artifact, coordinate-receipt, bridge-message, session, and dissolution contracts.
Serve one deterministic no-network 2D/3D workbench through the composed Construction Spatial Foundry using a sandboxed same-origin iframe.
Compile every accepted parent command and child receipt through the canonical six-slot Spatial interaction owner.
Require current admitted session state, exact command/receipt binding, exact origin, exact sequence, and one-time nonce.
Preserve the PR 1 Construction Spatial Foundry when Pascal assets are missing or invalid.
negative_requirements: Do not create a second Construction truth, Spatial truth, routing, verification, persistence, archive, authority, rollback, or learning plane.
Do not enable Pascal MCP mutation, persistent canonical browser storage, external asset fetch, remote plugins, or automatic execution.
Do not treat visual alignment as survey, safety, professional, payment, access, or physical-work authority.
Do not accept caller-supplied session identity, origin, digest, sequence, nonce, direction, or state-binding evidence.
Do not merge automatically and do not regenerate CODEMAP during substantive source review.
exit_gates: The deterministic local fixture presents 2D and 3D views, storey isolation, selection, dimensions, reset, and clean relaunch.
No external request or persistent canonical storage is admitted.
Exact Pascal source identity, scene identity, coordinate identity, and bridge identity are retained.
Wrong origin, sequence gaps, nonce replay, digest tampering, hidden-storey selection, and post-dissolution messages fail closed.
Renderer, listeners, timers, buffers, IndexedDB namespace, and parent iframe have exact dissolution evidence.
All Construction, survey, professional, payment, access, execution, patch, merge, and deployment authority remains false.
PR 1 routes and browser surface remain available when Pascal is absent.
